en: Attention passengers on flight 824 to London Heathrow.
kr: 런던 히드로행 824편 승객 여러분께 안내 말씀 드립니다.

en: Where is the departure gate for my flight?
Your gate is B22, located down the hallway to your right.
kr: 탑승구는 B22이며, 오른쪽 복도를 따라 내려가시면 있습니다.

en: How many pieces of carry-on luggage can I bring onboard?
kr: 기내 수하물로 몇 개까지 반입할 수 있나요?

en: Please have your boarding pass and passport ready for inspection.
kr: 검사를 위해 탑승권과 여권을 준비해 주세요.
